title: Steam Deck Suspend Drain Watch
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=steamdeck:session event=suspend
| stats avg(suspend_battery_loss_pct) as avg_loss_pct, max(suspend_battery_loss_pct) as max_loss_pct by device
| where avg_loss_pct>5 OR max_loss_pct>10
| sort - avg_loss_pct
description: Uses Steam Deck suspend telemetry telemetry to monitor battery drain while devices are supposed to be sleeping in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for suspend behavior that eats away at portability, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Steam Deck suspend telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Device table of average and max suspend battery loss.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges battery drain while devices are supposed to be sleeping so you can spot suspend behavior that eats away at portability before it becomes annoying.
